Global EU runs on Europe/Berlin: the game's own 01 91 list announced the Abyss siege bosses for Sat 21:35 and Sun 21:05 CEST. NA/Asia zones are community estimates. Check the rift grid after the DST change (EU 2026-10-25).

fieldBossRespawnMinutes._note: Respawn after a kill by map id and place (slot - map x 100). Learned live from the game's own list when a kill is seen; these are the start values (verified: Altgard 1, 2, 9, 11, 13, 18, 21, 22 and roughly 23, 24; the rest are half the TW intervals, which matches every verified one).

bossRespawnMinutesByNpc._note: Respawn after a kill by NPC code, for bosses on maps the field-boss list cannot be matched on yet (Elyos side). Estimates: half the TW intervals, like every verified Altgard one. Your own kills plus the game's list correct them.

bossPriorities._note: NPC code -> priority (top / high / medium). Starred by default from high up. Gartua: level 51, level 70 gear incl. helmet, Pantheon artwork. Dartan / Kashapa / Lagta: boss chests, gear, collection (first kill achievements). Lawa: Elyos, part of the Gartua boss rush.
